У нас runbook живёт прямо в annotations PrometheusRule, CI потом собирает из них страницу. Первый алерт я уже оформил, сделай остальные два ровно так же, я вставлю кусок прямо в файл под этим:

```yaml
    - alert: PaymentsApiHighErrorRate
      expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="payments-api",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="payments-api"}[5m])) > 0.05
      for: 5m
      labels:
        severity: critical
        team: payments
      annotations:
        summary: "payments-api: >5% ответов 5xx"
        impact: "Пользователи не могут оплатить заказ"
        mitigation: "kubectl rollout undo deployment/payments-api -n payments"
        dashboard: "https://grafana.internal/d/payments-api"
```

Оставшиеся: PaymentsApiPodCrashLooping (под перезапускается >3 раз за 15 минут, namespace payments) и PaymentsDbConnectionsExhausted (pgbouncer в payments-db, занято >90% пула клиентских соединений, метрика pgbouncer_pools_client_active_connections / pgbouncer_config_max_client_connections).
cases.why_in_scope: The user primes the exact structure (list-item indentation, key order, annotation keys, Russian summaries, single mitigation command) and wants a continuation to paste into the same file. Output priming makes the model continue that skeleton verbatim instead of switching to its own default markdown alert-card format. A strong model under the alerts_describer persona is plausibly pulled toward its mandatory card template or adds extra annotation keys, breaking the paste-in YAML.
rubric: Returns two YAML rule entries that match the given entry's structure: same indentation level ('    - alert:'), same keys in the same order (alert, expr, for, labels{severity, team}, annotations{summary, impact, mitigation, dashboard}) with no extra or missing annotation keys
Does not replace the YAML with a markdown alert card or tables; any prose outside the YAML block is at most a short note

The CrashLooping expr plausibly uses a restart-count metric such as increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="payments"}[15m]) > 3, and the DB expr uses the ratio of the two pgbouncer metrics named by the user compared with 0.9
Each mitigation is a single concrete command with the namespace set (e.g. a rollout undo/restart for the crash-looping pods), consistent with the style of the first entry

Начал рисовать sequence для оформления заказа, успешный путь готов. Допиши ветку, когда платёжный шлюз отвечает таймаутом: мы ретраим один раз через 2 секунды, если снова таймаут — заказ переводится в статус PENDING_PAYMENT, пользователю показываем «Проверяем оплату», а воркер reconciliation потом дергает шлюз по orderId. Стиль и обозначения не меняй, у нас так во всей доке.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as Покупатель
    participant FE as Web
    participant OS as OrderSvc
    participant PG as PayGateway
    U->>FE: Нажимает «Оплатить»
    FE->>OS: POST /orders/{id}/pay
    OS->>PG: charge(orderId, amount)
    alt успех
        PG-->>OS: 200 OK (txId)
        OS-->>FE: status=PAID
        FE-->>U: «Заказ оплачен»
```
cases.why_in_scope: The user provides an unfinished diagram as a primed prefix and explicitly asks to continue it in the same conventions. Output priming means extending the given structure (the open alt block gets an else branch and is closed with end, same aliases, Russian labels, autonumber) rather than redesigning. A strong model often rewrites the diagram, renames participants, switches to English labels, or forgets to close the already-open alt block.
rubric: Keeps the existing header and all existing lines unchanged: autonumber, aliases U/FE/OS/PG, Russian message labels and the arrow styles already used (->> for requests, -->> for responses)
Adds the timeout branch as an else inside the already-open alt, closes it with end, and the resulting Mermaid is syntactically valid

Models the described logic: a single retry after 2 s (e.g. via a loop/opt or a Note), then PENDING_PAYMENT status, the «Проверяем оплату» message to the user, and a reconciliation worker participant querying the gateway by orderId
A new participant for the reconciliation worker follows the same 'participant XX as Name' convention; no unrelated restructuring of the success path
